sections.kicker: Prepared for Sheike by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Sheike's Instagram is a world. The site is a catalogue.
sections.keep: Your Instagram highlights, from FLORAL ATELIER to SCENT WORKSHOP. They show a house with events, not just a rack of dresses.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Discover our Resort 27 Collection, ATTESA Chapter I
pins.what: Instagram tells the season as a story, with a name and a chapter.
pins.why: That story is why someone picks Sheike over the next dress label. It is the thing that feels off when it goes missing.
pins.how: Carry the ATTESA chapter onto the first screen of the site, in the same words.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Visitors who arrive from Instagram land somewhere that no longer feels like Sheike.

pins.what: The first screen of the site is a banner over rows of product tiles.
pins.why: Nothing on it speaks in Sheike's own voice, so it reads like any fashion store.
pins.how: Open with one image and one line from the current chapter before the grid.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: The homepage looks interchangeable with stores that sell for less.
pins.area: a banner over rows of product tiles with names and sizes

pins.what: Spa days, a scent workshop and a styling suite live only in your highlights.
pins.why: These are experiences no fast fashion rival owns.
pins.how: Give them a place on the site as part of who Sheike is.
pins.label: Your highlights
pins.cost: The richest part of the brand stays a story that disappears in a day.

sections.intro: You said something feels off and you can't name it. I think I can: your site and your Instagram read like two different brands. Here is where it shows.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Sheike's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Aesop, from another category. Every store and every page reads like the same room.
